amendments.body: Pre-existing test failure must be fixed: `step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error` in crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs fails because the engine recomputes habitat registry `light_exposure` values before invariant validation runs. When validation rejects the state (e.g., invalid `shrimp_assimilation_efficiency`), the returned state has been partially mutated (light_exposure values differ by 2x from the clone taken before `step_hours`). The engine should either snapshot state before any mutation and restore on validation failure, or defer habitat registry recomputation until after validation passes.
amendments.rationale: While this bug predates the CO2 exchange task, it is present in the current tree, is a real correctness issue (violates the contract that failed validation leaves state untouched), and will cause CI failures. It should be tracked and fixed, even if not blocking this specific task's acceptance.

amendments.body: The `check_strictly_increasing` helper in crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:398-409 only reports the upper field name and value in its error. When the invariant fires (e.g., `optimal_temp_min_c >= optimal_temp_max_c`), the error says `InvariantViolation { field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c", value: X }` without mentioning the lower bound that caused the conflict. Consider including both field names or a more descriptive message to aid debugging.
amendments.rationale: Minor ergonomic issue. When a user hits this invariant violation, they only see the upper field and have to infer the lower field from context. Including both values or a richer message would make the error self-explanatory.

payload.summary: Reviewed the CO2 gas exchange implementation (tanksim-6e5.4.3) and associated changes (shrimp invariant validation, save migration, feeding weight consistency fix). The CO2 exchange model is scientifically correct: Henry's law with van 't Hoff temperature correction, K_LA(CO2) = K_LA(O2) × 0.91 with Euler cap, proper DIC-only modification (alkalinity conserved), and correct carbon budget tracking. All 12 CO2 exchange tests pass, as do all 21 chemistry tests and 25 save/load tests. One pre-existing test failure exists in validation.rs (step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error) that predates this task's changes — the engine recomputes habitat registry light_exposure before invariant validation, so a failed validation returns partially-mutated state.
